description: This file declares the Shutdown class, which is a task for shutting down a WebAudio player within the Rialto server. It includes necessary headers, defines the class with constructor, destructor, and execute method, and references external classes and libraries.

classes.name: Shutdown
classes.description: A class representing a shutdown task for the WebAudio player, inheriting from IPlayerTask, with methods to execute the shutdown process.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the shutdown task with a reference to the WebAudio player.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the shutdown operation for the WebAudio player.
